selection: Public primary-source publications, instructional material, published spreadsheets and ebooks. No parser test fixtures or newly authored synthetic inputs. SHA-256 ranked within format, one per publication landing page, exact and package-text duplicate exclusions. All exclusions recorded before converter runs. If rare formats lack independent eligible inputs, retain the actual shortfall, do not manufacture variants; add available publications in other formats to reach at least 100.
independence: Check input hashes against recorded previous reports and fixture trees; also review publication families. Independence is from recorded development inputs, not a claim that AI model pretraining excluded public documents.

timing.headline: median across documents of each document's median measured conversion time; format-macro average also reported

quality.output_contract: GitHub-Flavored Markdown with valid semantic HTML tables allowed consistently for all engines; no automatic penalty solely for HTML syntax
quality.pairing: BulkParse against each supported comparator; both A/B orders; tool identities hidden from judge
quality.aggregation: average orders, average each document once per engine, average documents within format, macro-average supported formats
quality.failed_attempts: empty output retained; zero content score where nonblank reference exists
quality.references: first six rendered pages or slides; native package/source evidence where layout rendering is unavailable; only score content visible in supplied references
quality.truncation: explicitly recorded, same limit for all engines, do not penalize content outside reference scope
quality.human_review: fixed seeded sample of verdicts plus all large order disagreements; no claim of human review before it occurs

paid_jobs: disabled until the user approves a concrete payload manifest and estimated cost
readme: publish scores only after validated returned verdicts; pending stages labeled
